title.narrative: Roots & Rights: Growing Climate Solidarity between Youth

description.narrative: The activity is a regional climate activist camp in Phuket, Thailand. It is a part of a project about young indigenous climate activists in Thailand/Malaysia which began in 2022. A Operation Dagsv�rk (OD) project with AIPP, IMPECT, PACOS and IWGIA). The camp's goal is to connect the young participants from the project so they can exchange experiences and become better activists. The camp's target group is indigenous activists (15-30 years), whose participation is funded by the original project. We, the Danish volunteers, have since its start in 2022, worked together on the project with the indigenous youth. We wish to contribute to the camp with knowledge of youth activities in Denmark and how the project has progressed in Denmark.
